5030101.text: This is the Chihu Rock Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

5030102.text: "When water's natural purity is preserved, disease cannot fester. But when sullied at its source, it gives rise to all manner of plagues and pestilences. Therefore, let the one who pollutes a water source through negligence be shown leniency, but let any that would willfully pollute a water source be shown no mercy whatsoever."

5030103.text: In response to the recent pollution of Feiyun Slope's water source, Yujing Terrace has sent someone to urgently deal with it. In a few days, the water will be clean as ever.

5030104.text: The Millelith hereby remind all who come to fetch water at Chihu Rock to follow the rules and avoid polluting the water.

5030105.text: Violators who break the rules and pollute the water source will be severely punished by the Millelith.

5030202.text: Exquisite delicacies that cater to all tastes!

5030203.text: An all new flavor that reminds you of the good ol' days!

5030206.text: "Sincerest apologies, but my daughter is out traveling the seven nations of Teyvat studying the culinary arts. It may be some time before she returns."

5030302.text: Prestigious cooking and a sharp knife!

5030303.text: A fast blade, roaring fire, and authentic grilled fish!

5030304.text: If you want to eat the most authentic Grilled Tiger Fish in Liyue, come to Chen the Sharp!

5030305.text: "How's business? Do you have time to reminisce with an old friend of the Guhua Clan?"

5030306.text: "Certainly, just let me know where! Or you could come by my restaurant — food and drinks on me!"

5030402.text: Hanfeng's cold blades are sharp as can be!

5030403.text: Hanfeng's Ironmongers is the blacksmith of the people! Whether you are a gallant knight or a common old lady, we have just the blade for you!

5030501.text: This is the Chihu Rock Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

5030502.text: "I recently lost a spear that looks similar to that used by the Millelith. I will be immensely grateful if anyone helps me find it!"

5030503.text: "If you find the spear or have any information as to where it may be, please meet me near the shipyard."

5030504.text: "No matter if you are a Liyue resident or a traveler from afar, I would really appreciate your help."

5030602.text: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome to the Liyue branch of the Adventurers' Guild.

5030603.text: When gazing at the night sky, do you find yourself yearning to reach the stars?

5030604.text: When overlooking a perilous abyss, do you find yourself wondering what treasure lies at the bottom?

5030605.text: Sign up for the Adventurers' Guild! Let's conquer all the world's dangers and uncover all the world's secrets together.

5030606.text: Please talk to Katheryne for more information.

5030702.text: Fresh Fish Stall's fish is absolutely fresh! Fair prices for high quality — no haggling, please!

5030703.text: Fresher Fish Stall's fish is absolutely fresher! Our service is top-notch and prices are low!

5030802.text: Come to Third-Round Knockout to enjoy our famous wine made from centuries-old fermentation methods!

5030803.text: After three blissful bowls of wine-fermented sweet rice balls you won't want to leave port!

5030901.text: This is the Chihu Rock Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

5030902.text: "I'm no good at advertisements, so I just decided to post a note on the message board!"

5030903.text: "Cheap 'n' tasty Zhongyuan Chop Suey! Fragrant, spicy, and guaranteed to satisfy your taste buds!"

5030904.text: "Dear Madam Su, this is a Bulletin Board for announcements, not messages..."

5030905.text: "To publish ads, please register with the Millelith... and please refrain from posting unrelated messages here."

5030906.text: "Sorry to trouble you, boys! Come by for a meal when you're off your shift, I'll give you a discount!"

5031001.text: This is the Chihu Rock Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

5031002.text: "Each day the high and low tides come to shore, each splash of the sea different from the last."

5031003.text: "I still sit here watching the waves join and part, thinking of you."

5031004.text: "When will you return from some vast sea far away and see this message, my heart poured out for you to see?"

5031005.text: "When will we be able to fulfill our promises, made to each other long ago?"

5031006.text: "Please do not post love letters on the Bulletin Board. Thank you."

5031101.text: This is the Chihu Rock Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

5031102.text: Most mining at the Chasm has been shut down, but illegal mining and smuggling activity has increased recently.

5031103.text: We urge Liyue residents to take extra caution and cooperate with Millelith soldiers as they work to apprehend the smugglers.

5031104.text: Jade vendors should similarly strictly abide by the law. Heavy fines will be issued to anyone engaging in the sale of smuggled minerals.

5031201.text: This is the Chihu Rock Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

5031202.text: Life can be as precious as jade if you dig past the rocky exterior. Make acute, quick decisions in life, or you will regret missed opportunities.

5031203.text: But while we only live once, we can enjoy the joy of jade many-a-time. Which is more exciting, embarking on a daring adventure or receiving a beautiful piece of jade?

5031204.text: Just a small price for a big surprise.

5031205.text: Delights and good luck await you at The Jade Mystery!

5031206.text: A cartload of uncut jade has just arrived. Come by to marvel its beauty, and purchase if so inclined!

5031301.text: This is the Chihu Rock Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

5031302.text: Elegant like jade and delicate like a rose, my wares are a feast for the eyes and pleasure to touch.

5031303.text: Smooth, shapely, soft, fragrant, and charming as a cool spring morning.

5031304.text: Have even a wisp of the scent of spring and you will never forget it. You and fine porcelain are perfect for each other.

5031402.text: Come have a relaxing evening tea at Yanshang Teahouse, your safe haven after a hard day of work.

5031403.text: Our establishment only serves the highest-quality teas. A deposit is required when entering, thank you for your understanding.

5031501.text: This is the Chihu Rock Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

5031502.text: "I officially start as a member of the Millelith tomorrow! Let's drink until the sun rises, everyone!"

5031503.text: "My stinkin' father said I'd never become a soldier. Well, look at me now, pops!"

5031504.text: "Tomorrow morning you are to report for patrol, recruit. Remember there's punishment for failed inspection."

5031505.text: "The Millelith need to set an example for our citizens and only post serious announcements on the bulletin board."

5031601.text: This is the Chihu Rock Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

5031602.text: There has been smuggling activity recently in the area near Bibo's Fish Market. We ask residents to be vigilant and report any suspicious activity to the Millelith.

5031603.text: Furthermore, by order of the Qixing, the Millelith will be increasing license inspection of vendors at Bibo's Fish Market. We ask vendors to prepare their licenses accordingly.

5031701.text: This is the Chihu Rock Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

5031702.text: Due to popular demand from residents and Millelith alike, a special space at the south wharf has been designated for performances by the up-and-coming Xinyan.

5031703.text: Enthusiasts of Fontaine music are welcome to come and enjoy, but please maintain order when attending to avoid injuring yourself or others.

5031704.text: "Please do not insult my craft! My unique sound belongs to me, not Fontaine!"

5031801.text: This is the Chihu Rock Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

5031802.text: "Who is that fox at the Yanshang Teahouse? Last time I had the misfortune of sharing a table with her I spent all of my money!"

5031803.text: "I can't stand to even think of those beady fox eyes! I forget that she's the teahouse steward — she acts like a swindler!"

5031804.text: "If the fox sees this post, please respond. Just see how arrogant you are when I get my friends to come!"

5031805.text: "Don't worry, your friends are already waiting for you at the dock. (I went ahead and bought some medicine for them. You can pick it up first.)"
